required_actions: iPhone 15: Settings > Battery > Charging (critical)
Charge limit slider from 80 to 100 percent; to charge past 80 percent change the limit (critical)

unsupported_claims: Choose an option on the slider for the charge limit... set it **below 100%** to turn it off. -> this contradicts the user's goal: a limit below 100% makes the iPhone stop charging at that limit; the page says to change the limit to charge past 80 percent
Charge Now / Charging menu steps -> not on cited page 108805 (they are on https://support.apple.com/en-ca/108055)
reasons: Final reply sends the user to set a limit below 100%, which would keep the phone stopping early, the opposite of what they want. Wear warning from the earlier turn was dropped for the iPhone 15 path.
fix: Cite https://support.apple.com/en-ca/108055 as well. Rewrite the final reply for an iPhone 15: 1) Settings, tap Battery. 2) Tap Charging. 3) On the slider, if the limit is below 100%, move it to 100% so the phone can charge fully (page: you can choose a limit between 80 and 100 percent in 5 percent steps). Then explain in one plain sentence that at 100% Optimized Battery Charging may still hold at 80% on some nights, and that turning off charging optimizations can wear the battery faster. Keep the one-day option: touch and hold the Lock Screen notification and tap Charge Now. Remove the 'set it below 100% to turn it off' advice.
